title: Housing Wealth Across Countries: The Role of Expectations, Institutions and Preferences
title_zh: 跨国住房财富：预期、制度与偏好的作用
title_primary: 跨国住房财富：预期、制度与偏好的作用
title_secondary: Housing Wealth Across Countries: The Role of Expectations, Institutions and Preferences
authors: Julia Le Blanc, Jiri Slacalek, Matthew White
official: 官方在线 2025-01-08 · 来源：出版社网页
abstract: Homeownership rates and holdings of housing wealth differ immensely across countries. We specify and estimate a life cycle model with risky labor income and house prices in which households face a discrete–continuous choice between renting and owning a house, whose sale is subject to transaction costs. The model allows us to quantify three groups of explanatory factors for long-run, structural differences in the extensive and intensive margins of housing: the homeownership rate and the value of housing wealth of homeowners. First, in line with survey evidence, we allow for differences in expectations of house prices. Second, countries differ in the institutional set-up of the housing market: maximum loan–value ratio and costs of renting, maintaining, and selling a house. Third, we allow for differences in household preferences: the dispersion in discount factors, the share of housing expenditure, and the bequest motive. We estimate the model using micro data from five large economies and provide a decomposition to interpret what drives the cross-country differences in housing wealth. We find that all three groups of factors matter, although preferences less so. Differences in homeownership rates are strongly affected by (i) house price beliefs and (ii) the rental wedge, the difference between rents and maintenance costs, which reflects the quality of the rental market. Differences in the value of housing wealth are substantially driven by housing maintenance costs.
abstract_zh: 各国住房拥有率及住房财富持有量差异显著。我们构建并估计了一个包含风险劳动收入与房价的生命周期模型，其中家庭面临租赁与购买住房之间的离散-连续选择，且房屋出售需承担交易成本。该模型使我们能够量化三类解释因素，用以说明住房在广延边际与集约边际上的长期结构性差异，即住房拥有率与房主住房财富价值。首先，与调查证据一致，我们允许房价预期存在差异。其次，各国在住房市场制度安排上有所不同：最高贷款价值比以及租赁、维护和出售房屋的成本各异。第三，我们允许家庭偏好存在差异：折现因子的离散程度、住房支出份额以及遗赠动机。我们利用五个大型经济体的微观数据对模型进行估计，并提供一种分解方法，以解读驱动跨国住房财富差异的因素。我们发现，所有三类因素均具有重要性，尽管偏好的影响相对较小。住房拥有率的差异主要受以下因素影响：（i）房价信念及（ii）租赁楔子，即租金与维护成本之间的差额，该差额反映了租赁市场的质量。住房财富价值的差异则主要由住房维护成本驱动。

title: Reducing early secondary school leaving: experimental evidence on information, tutoring, and incentives from Burkina Faso
title_zh: 减少初中辍学：来自布基纳法索关于信息、辅导与激励的实验证据
title_primary: 减少初中辍学：来自布基纳法索关于信息、辅导与激励的实验证据
title_secondary: Reducing early secondary school leaving: experimental evidence on information, tutoring, and incentives from Burkina Faso
authors: Jan-Walter De Neve, Somkeita Pascal Zabré, Günther Fink
official: Crossref 元数据日期 2026-09-04 · 来源：Crossref
abstract: Despite major gains in primary school enrollment across low- and middle-income countries, secondary school completion remains low. We conducted a randomized controlled trial in Burkina Faso to evaluate the effectiveness of three interventions designed to reduce early secondary school leaving: (i) information on the economic and health returns to education, (ii) tailored tutoring, and (iii) conditional cash incentives. The cash intervention significantly increased school enrollment, any school attendance, and regular attendance, and reduced the total number of school days missed. Tutoring significantly increased school enrollment, while its effects on regular attendance and academic progression were imprecisely estimated. The information intervention generated limited evidence of impacts, with no statistically significant effects on the primary outcome or academic progression and only marginal evidence of an increase in any school attendance. Financial and academic support can help adolescents who left school early re-enroll, but larger studies are needed to identify which interventions most effectively sustain regular attendance.
abstract_zh: 尽管低收入和中等收入国家的小学入学率取得了显著进步，但中学完成率仍然较低。我们在布基纳法索进行了一项随机对照试验，评估旨在减少初中辍学的三项干预措施的有效性：（一）关于教育经济与健康回报的信息提供，（二）个性化辅导，以及（三）有条件现金激励。现金干预显著提高了学校注册率、任何形式的出勤率及规律出勤率，并减少了总缺课天数。辅导显著提升了学校注册率，但其对规律出勤和学业进展的影响估计不够精确。信息干预对主要结果或学业进展未显示出统计学显著影响，仅在增加任何形式的出勤方面有边际证据。财政和学业支持有助于早期辍学的青少年重新入学，但需更大规模的研究来确定哪些干预措施能最有效地维持规律出勤。

title: Immigrants in Finance: Evidence from Hedge Funds
title_zh: 金融领域的移民：来自对冲基金的证据
title_primary: 金融领域的移民：来自对冲基金的证据
title_secondary: Immigrants in Finance: Evidence from Hedge Funds
authors: Jun Chen, Shenje Hshieh, Melvyn Teo, Feng Zhang
official: 官方在线 2026-09-03 · 来源：RSS
abstract: We examine the value of skilled immigrants in finance by exploiting evidence from visa lotteries. We find that hedge fund management companies that secure more H-1B visas in random lotteries deliver higher alphas, Sharpe ratios, and information ratios. The superior performance of funds with high H-1B visa allocations can be attributed to well-paid and highly educated H-1B workers with quantitative skills. H-1B workers add value by helping hedge funds develop distinctive investment strategies, arbitrage prominent stock anomalies, and overcome capacity constraints. Hedge funds appear to exploit labor market frictions as alpha generation is greatest by workers from countries with the longest wait times for U.S. permanent residency. This paper was accepted by Lukas Schmid, finance. Supplemental Material: The online appendix and data files are available at https://doi.org/10.1287/mnsc.2024.07615 .
abstract_zh: 我们利用签证抽签的证据，考察了金融领域技术移民的价值。研究发现，在随机抽签中获得更多H-1B签证的对冲基金管理公司，其阿尔法、夏普比率和信息比率均更高。高H-1B签证配额基金的卓越表现可归因于具备量化技能、高薪且高学历的H-1B员工。H-1B员工通过帮助对冲基金开发独特投资策略、套利显著股票异象以及克服容量限制来增加价值。对冲基金似乎利用了劳动力市场摩擦，因为来自美国永久居留等待时间最长国家的员工所产生的阿尔法最大。本文已被金融领域的Lukas Schmid接受。补充材料：在线附录和数据文件可在https://doi.org/10.1287/mnsc.2024.07615获取。

title: Does slow strategizing indicate optimal behavior or uncertainty?
title_zh: 缓慢的战略制定意味着最优行为还是不确定性？
title_primary: 缓慢的战略制定意味着最优行为还是不确定性？
title_secondary: Does slow strategizing indicate optimal behavior or uncertainty?
authors: Ian Krajbich
source: Journal of Economic Behavior and Organization
official: Crossref 元数据日期 2026-08-22 · 来源：Crossref
abstract: In simple choice, slower decisions tend to indicate proximity to indifference and thus less predictable choice. In complex situations, some studies have argued that slower decisions indicate more reasoning and thus more optimal decisions. However, those studies rely on games where the optimal responses are debatable – they depend on agents’ beliefs or social preferences. Thus, it is unclear whether being slow is a good or bad sign. Here, we examine whether fast decisions are more or less optimal in high and low complexity, zero-sum games with dominant strategies and limited social-preference concerns. We study repeated 2-person p-beauty contests, where halfway through the experiment we switch the multiplier, changing the dominant strategy. Only 33% of subjects correctly adjusted after the switch, an indication of understanding the dominant strategy. Those who continued to play the dominant strategy showed a decrease in response time (RT) upon playing the dominant strategy, while those who later switched away from the dominant strategy did not. Contrary to the predictions for complex games, subjects exhibited negative correlations between RT and optimal choice, both in the early rounds and after the switch. Thus, we find no support for the notion that slower decisions result in better choices.
abstract_zh: 在简单选择中，较慢的决策往往表明接近无差异状态，从而预测性较低。在复杂情境下，一些研究认为较慢的决策意味着更多的推理，因此更可能产生最优决策。然而，这些研究依赖于最优反应存在争议的博弈——它们取决于参与者的信念或社会偏好。因此，尚不清楚决策缓慢是积极信号还是消极信号。在此，我们考察在具有主导策略且社会偏好关注有限的高、低复杂度零和博弈中，快速决策是否更优或更劣。我们研究了重复进行的两人p-美容竞赛，在实验中途切换乘数，从而改变主导策略。仅有33%的受试者在切换后正确调整，这表明他们理解了主导策略。那些继续采用主导策略的受试者在执行主导策略时反应时间（RT）有所下降，而那些后来偏离主导策略的受试者则没有表现出这种下降。与复杂博弈的预测相反，受试者在早期轮次及切换后均表现出反应时间与最优选择之间的负相关。因此，我们没有发现支持“较慢决策导致更好选择”这一观点的证据。

title: Spatial scale of agglomeration and dispersion: Number, spacing, and the spatial extent of cities
title_zh: 集聚与分散的空间尺度：城市数量、间距及空间范围
title_primary: 集聚与分散的空间尺度：城市数量、间距及空间范围
title_secondary: Spatial scale of agglomeration and dispersion: Number, spacing, and the spatial extent of cities
authors: Takashi Akamatsu, Tomoya Mori, Minoru Osawa, Yuki Takayama
official: 官方在线 2026-08-19 · 来源：RSS
abstract: Cities have become fewer, bigger, and flatter in many countries. Better transport access has fostered the concentration of economic activities toward fewer, bigger cities, while each city has become more decentralized. We show that two types of dispersion forces against spatial agglomeration explain the dual evolution of cities. Dispersion forces within a city, such as those arising from the consumption of limited land, affect only the city's residents. A decrease in transport costs reduces the relative benefits of agglomeration in a congested central location, making the population distribution in each city flatter and more spread out to achieve a balance between the costs and benefits of agglomeration. Dispersion forces that spill over beyond a city, such as market crowding, make locations near the city unattractive. Lower transport costs promote competition for a wider area around each city, leaving fewer cities with larger distances between them. A model's comparative static results, and thus its policy implications, depend on the type of dispersion forces it incorporates.
abstract_zh: 运输成本如何影响经济活动的空间组织？本研究构建了一个理论框架，区分了空间模型中的两类分散力：“本地”分散力作用于城市内部，而“全球”分散力则作用于城市之间。这一区分使得空间模型得以系统性地归类为几种基本类型，每种类型具有不同的内生空间格局及对运输成本变化的比较静态响应。该框架调和了实证发现，并阐明了运输引发的经济活动重组如何取决于主导分散力的空间尺度。

title: Dynamic Equilibrium with Costly Short-Selling and Lending Market
title_zh: 成本卖空与借贷市场中的动态均衡
title_primary: 成本卖空与借贷市场中的动态均衡
title_secondary: Dynamic Equilibrium with Costly Short-Selling and Lending Market
authors: Adem Atmaz, Suleyman Basak, Fangcheng Ruan, Alessandro Beber, Daniela Fabbri 等
official: 官方在线 2023-06-30 · 来源：文章页面
abstract: We develop a dynamic model of costly stock short-selling and lending market and obtain implications that simultaneously support many empirical regularities related to short-selling. In our model, investors’ belief disagreement leads to shorting demand, whereby short-sellers pay shorting fees to borrow stocks from lenders. Our main novel results are as follows. Short interest is positively related to shorting fee and predicts stock returns negatively. Higher short-selling risk can be associated with lower stock returns and less short-selling activity. Stock volatility is increased under costly short-selling. An application to GameStop episode yields implications consistent with observed patterns.
abstract_zh: 我们构建了一个关于高成本股票卖空与借贷市场的动态模型，并得出了同时支持众多与卖空相关的实证规律的含义。在我们的模型中，投资者信念分歧导致卖空需求，卖空者因此向贷方支付卖空费用以借入股票。我们的主要新颖结果如下：卖空兴趣与卖空费用正相关，并对股票收益产生负面预测作用。较高的卖空风险可能与较低的股票收益和较少的卖空活动相关联。在高成本卖空条件下，股票波动性增加。将模型应用于GameStop事件所得出的含义与观察到的模式相符。

title: The Mitigating Effects of Unemployment Insurance on Short-Run Mortality
title_zh: 失业保险对短期死亡率的缓解效应
title_primary: 失业保险对短期死亡率的缓解效应
title_secondary: The Mitigating Effects of Unemployment Insurance on Short-Run Mortality
authors: Hill, Andrew, Regmi, Krishna, Swensen, Isaac
official: 官方在线 2026-08-17 · 来源：文章页面
abstract: Unprecedented increases in unemployment insurance (UI) claims and dramatic changes in UI delivery across the U.S. in recent years stress the importance of understanding the wide-ranging effects of UI receipt. We estimate the short-run effect of UI on suicide and drug overdose mortality following mass layoff events. Using quarterly county-level data from 1995-2010 and leveraging interactions between state-specific UI generosity and mass layoff events, our two-way fixed effects models and event studies show that more generous UI reduces suicide at the county level. These mitigation effects coincide with otherwise large spikes in mortality following mass layoff events in local communities. We find no effect on drug overdose deaths.
abstract_zh: 近年来，美国失业保险（UI）申请数量空前激增，且UI发放方式发生剧烈变化，这凸显了理解UI领取广泛影响的重要性。我们估算了大规模裁员事件后UI对自杀和药物过量死亡率的短期效应。利用1995年至2010年的季度县级数据，并借助州特定UI慷慨程度与大规模裁员事件之间的交互作用，我们的双向固定效应模型和事件研究显示，更慷慨的UI降低了县级自杀率。这些缓解效应与当地社区在大规模裁员事件后死亡率本会出现的急剧上升形成对比。我们未发现UI对药物过量死亡有影响。

title: The Intrinsic Valuation of Biodiversity Loss
title_zh: 生物多样性损失的内在价值评估
title_primary: 生物多样性损失的内在价值评估
title_secondary: The Intrinsic Valuation of Biodiversity Loss
authors: Adrien Bilal, Noémie Pinardon-Touati, Conor Walsh
official: 官方在线 2026-08-17 · 来源：出版社网页
abstract: We explore the welfare costs of the loss of animal life in a consequentialist total utilitarian framework that incorporates the intrinsic value of living beings through their sentience. Moral philosophy and neuroscience define sentience as the capacity for valenced experience. Observable performance on cognitive tests represents a conservative lower bound on sentience under plausible neuroscientific assumptions. We estimate the relationship between cognition and neuron counts to cardinalize sentience. We collect population and neuron data for a wide range of animal species, and aggregate them into a single welfare measure. Across a wide range of parameters, the aggregate sentience losses of animals in the past half century outstrip the sentience gains to humans from population growth by at least 10,000-fold. Breaking even in welfare terms requires assigning a correspondingly small welfare weight to animals. Including the benefits of economic growth to humans does little to change these overall welfare losses.
abstract_zh: 我们探讨了在后果主义总体功利主义框架下动物生命丧失的福利成本，该框架通过感知能力将生物的内在价值纳入考量。道德哲学与神经科学将感知能力定义为体验效价的能力。在合理的神经科学假设下，认知测试中的可观察表现代表了感知能力的一个保守下限。我们估算了认知与神经元数量之间的关系，以对感知能力进行基数化度量。我们收集了广泛动物物种的种群及神经元数据，并将其汇总为单一的福利指标。在广泛的参数范围内，过去半个世纪中动物的总体感知损失至少超过人口增长给人类带来的感知收益一万倍。要在福利上达到平衡，需要赋予动物相应微小的福利权重。将经济增长对人类的好处纳入考量，也几乎不会改变这些总体福利损失。

title: Hydropower development, resettlement, and urban water security: Evidence from Brazil’s Belo Monte Dam
title_zh: 水电开发、移民安置与城市水安全：来自巴西贝罗蒙特大坝的证据
title_primary: 水电开发、移民安置与城市水安全：来自巴西贝罗蒙特大坝的证据
title_secondary: Hydropower development, resettlement, and urban water security: Evidence from Brazil’s Belo Monte Dam
authors: Heather Randell, Peter Taylor Klein, Thais Tartalha do Nascimento Lombardi, Thaise Constancio Temoteo
official: Crossref 元数据日期 2026-08-13 · 来源：Crossref
abstract: Millions of people are resettled each year when dam construction floods their homes and land. Dam building and its associated resettlement may impact water security by altering access to drinking water and sanitation, disrupting aquatic ecosystems, shifting local economies, and undermining the ability to use rivers for income, navigation, and cultural practices. This paper explores how dam-induced-displacement and resettlement in the Brazilian Amazon shaped women’s experiences of water (in)security along four dimensions: Access, Safety, Livelihoods, and Culture. We conducted in-depth interviews with 70 women in the city of Altamira who were impacted by the Belo Monte Dam and who had participated in household surveys before dam construction began. Our findings suggest that dam building and resettlement did not universally improve or degrade water security, but rather shifted it in uneven ways. While access to water improved for some women, the majority of respondents experienced water outages after the dam, some for weeks at a time. Safety from seasonal flooding and access to sanitation improved for many, though poor water quality and lack of maintenance of sanitation infrastructure created problems. Finally, resettlement and changes in river ecology undermined livelihoods for fisheries-dependent households and severed cultural connections to the river for many. These findings have crucial implications for health outcomes and can inform policies to improve the water security and well-being of populations resettled due to future dams, other development projects, and climate change.
abstract_zh: 每年，大坝建设淹没房屋和土地，导致数百万人被迫迁移。大坝建设及其相关的重新安置可能通过改变饮用水和卫生设施的获取途径、破坏水生生态系统、改变当地经济，以及削弱利用河流进行生计、航行和文化实践的能力，从而影响水安全。本文探讨了巴西亚马逊地区因大坝引发的流离失所和重新安置如何从四个维度——获取、安全、生计和文化——塑造了女性的水（不）安全体验。我们对阿尔塔米拉市的70名受贝洛蒙特水坝影响且在建设前参与过家庭调查的女性进行了深度访谈。研究结果表明，大坝建设和重新安置并未普遍改善或恶化水安全，而是以不均衡的方式改变了它。尽管部分女性的取水条件有所改善，但大多数受访者在大坝建成后经历了停水，有些甚至持续数周。对于许多人来说，季节性洪水的安全性和卫生设施的获取有所提升，但水质差和卫生设施维护不足带来了新的问题。最后，重新安置和河流生态的变化削弱了依赖渔业的家庭的生计，并切断了许多人与河流的文化联系。这些发现对健康结果具有重要影响，可为改善因未来大坝、其他开发项目及气候变化而重新安置的人口的用水安全和福祉提供政策参考。

title: Pareto-Improvements, Welfare Trade-Offs and the Taxation of Couples
title_zh: 帕累托改进、福利权衡与夫妻税收
title_primary: 帕累托改进、福利权衡与夫妻税收
title_secondary: Pareto-Improvements, Welfare Trade-Offs and the Taxation of Couples
authors: Felix Bierbrauer, Pierre Boyer, Daniel Weishaar
official: 官方在线 2024-12-09 · 来源：出版社网页
abstract: We develop a theory of tax reforms for a setting with multi-dimensional heterogeneity amongst taxpayers and multiple economic decisions that are all subject to fixed and variable costs. The theorems in this paper provide a complete characterization of the conditions under which Pareto- or welfare-improving tax reforms exist. We focus on one application, the taxation of couples, and present a detailed analysis of the behavioral responses to taxation in this setting. Squaring the theorems with this analysis yields sufficient statistics for the existence of Pareto- or welfare-improving tax reforms. In the empirical part, we apply them to US data. Our findings include the following: Tax rates on secondary earnings are inefficiently high when secondary earnings are close to primary earnings. Also, reducing the tax system's degree of jointness is not Pareto-improving. Whether it raises welfare depends on a trade-off between poverty alleviation and gender balance.
abstract_zh: 我们构建了一个关于税收改革的理论框架，适用于纳税人之间存在多维异质性且涉及多种经济决策，这些决策均受固定成本和可变成本影响的情形。本文中的定理全面刻画了存在帕累托改进或福利改进型税收改革的条件。我们聚焦于一个应用场景——夫妻税收问题，并对此情境下税收引致的行为反应进行了详尽分析。将定理与此分析相结合，得出了判断帕累托改进或福利改进型税收改革存在性的充分统计量。在实证部分，我们将这些统计量应用于美国数据。研究发现包括：当次要收入接近主要收入时，对次要收入征收的税率过高；此外，降低税收体系的联合程度并非帕累托改进。至于其是否能提升福利，则取决于减贫与性别平衡之间的权衡。

title: CRE Development Potential and the Selection of Opportunity Zones
title_zh: CRE开发潜力与机会区选择
title_primary: CRE开发潜力与机会区选择
title_secondary: CRE Development Potential and the Selection of Opportunity Zones
authors: David Glancy, Robert Kurtzman, Lara Loewenstein
official: 聚合元数据日期 2026-07-14 · 来源：文章页面
abstract: Place-based policies are often caught between two potentially conflicting aims: (i) directing aid to needy communities and (ii) spurring investment. We study this tradeoff in the context of the Opportunity Zones (OZ) program. Leveraging unique phase-level microdata on commercial construction projects, we show that US state governors prioritized designating tracts where construction projects were already being planned. About two-thirds of the greater construction growth in OZs can be attributed to this selection. States prioritizing tracts with greater investment opportunities observed larger construction increases in designated tracts. We calibrate a structural model to quantify the effects of the program and examine counterfactuals under alternative preferences or eligibility criteria.
abstract_zh: 基于地方的政策常常陷入两个可能相互冲突的目标之间：（一）将援助导向贫困社区，（二）刺激投资。我们在机会区（OZ）项目的背景下研究这一权衡。利用关于商业建筑项目的独特阶段级微观数据，我们表明美国各州州长优先指定那些已有建筑项目规划的区块。OZ中约三分之二的建筑增长可归因于这种选择。优先指定具有更大投资机会区块的州，在指定区块中观察到更大的建筑增长。我们校准了一个结构模型，以量化该项目的效果，并考察在替代偏好或资格标准下的反事实情景。

title: Patterns associated with circular economy practices: socioeconomic and infrastructural insights from Tehran
title_zh: 循环经济实践相关模式：德黑兰的社会经济与基础设施洞察
title_primary: 循环经济实践相关模式：德黑兰的社会经济与基础设施洞察

authors: Zahra Rostami, Saleh Ghavidel Doostkouei, Masoud Soufimajidpour, Mahmood Mahmoodzadeh
official: Crossref 元数据日期 2026-08-03 · 来源：Crossref
abstract: This study investigates the social, economic, cultural, and infrastructural factors associated with circular economy (CE) practices across 22 districts of Tehran from 2019 to 2023. Using recorded dry waste generation as an imperfect proxy for certain dimensions of circular economy behaviour, the analysis employs conventional and spatial panel data models to capture inter-district interactions and spillover effects. The results show that municipal revenues, urban infrastructure quality, demographic characteristics, and socioeconomic conditions significantly shape dry waste generation patterns and outcomes consistent with elements of circular economy behaviour. Higher municipal revenues and improved infrastructure (measured through both incident reports and the availability of public green spaces) are associated with lower per capita dry waste, with notable positive spillover effects on neighbouring districts. Demographic factors, particularly family size, also influence waste outcomes linked to circularity, while traditional lifestyles and poverty exhibit intertwined and mixed effects. The COVID-19 pandemic further contributed to temporary reductions in dry waste generation, with spatially diffused impacts across districts. Spatial panel results highlight strong inter-district dependencies, underscoring the importance of regional coordination in CE policy design. Overall, the study demonstrates that effective CE strategies in urban areas require integrated economic, infrastructural, and social interventions, alongside collaborative governance across districts.
abstract_zh: 本研究探讨了2019至2023年间德黑兰22个区循环经济实践相关的社会、经济、文化和基础设施因素。以记录的干垃圾产生量作为循环经济行为某些维度的不完全代理指标，分析采用常规及空间面板数据模型，以捕捉区域间互动与溢出效应。结果显示，市政收入、城市基础设施质量、人口特征和社会经济条件显著影响干垃圾产生模式及与循环经济行为要素相符的结果。较高的市政收入和改善的基础设施（通过事件报告和公共绿地可用性衡量）与人均干垃圾减少相关，并对邻近区域产生显著的正向溢出效应。人口因素，尤其是家庭规模，也影响与循环性相关的垃圾结果，而传统生活方式和贫困则表现出交织且混合的影响。新冠疫情进一步导致干垃圾产生量暂时减少，其影响在区域间呈空间扩散。空间面板结果凸显了区域间强烈的相互依赖性，强调了循环经济政策设计中区域协调的重要性。总体而言，研究表明，城市有效的循环经济策略需要经济、基础设施和社会干预的综合措施，以及跨区域的协作治理。

title: Scarred by nature: How early exposure to natural disasters shapes risk attitudes
title_zh: 被自然所伤：早期自然灾害经历如何塑造风险态度
title_primary: 被自然所伤：早期自然灾害经历如何塑造风险态度

official: Crossref 元数据日期 2026-07-28 · 来源：Crossref
abstract: Can early-life experiences shape long-term risk attitudes? This paper examines the relationship between exposure to natural disasters during early adulthood and individual risk preferences later in life. Using harmonized survey data linked to disaster records, we find that individuals exposed to natural disasters between the ages of 18 and 25 exhibit significantly greater risk aversion later in life. This relationship proves robust across a range of alternative specifications. We further explore the role of cultural transmission as a mechanism, showing that social connectedness moderates the observed behavioral shift. Our findings underscore the impressionable years as a critical window for the formation of individual preferences. The study offers new insights into how climate-related shocks are linked to long-lasting behavioral patterns, with implications for public policy, economic behavior, and climate adaptation.
abstract_zh: 早期生活经历能否塑造长期的风险态度？本文探讨了成年早期遭遇自然灾害与个体后期风险偏好之间的关系。利用与灾害记录相匹配的协调调查数据，我们发现，在18至25岁之间经历自然灾害的个体，在后期生活中表现出显著更高的风险规避倾向。这一关系在多种替代性设定下均保持稳健。我们进一步探讨了文化传播作为机制的作用，表明社会联系度调节了所观察到的行为转变。我们的研究结果强调了“可塑期”作为个体偏好形成的关键窗口期。本研究为气候相关冲击如何与持久的行为模式相关联提供了新见解，对公共政策、经济行为及气候适应具有启示意义。

title: Preference Shocks and Policy Responses to Transition Risk
title_zh: 偏好冲击与转型风险的政策应对
title_primary: 偏好冲击与转型风险的政策应对
title_secondary: Preference Shocks and Policy Responses to Transition Risk
authors: Stefano Carattini, Givi Melkadze, Inès Mourelon
official: 官方在线 2026-07-22 · 来源：出版社网页
abstract: Central banks and financial surveillance authorities need to cope with the potential realization of financial stability risks, adopting preventive measures or using liquidity once crises materialize. Transition risk — the stability risk associated with decarbonization — is a case in point. Such risk not only comes from policy changes, but also from preference shocks. Hence, this paper develops an environmental DSGE model with financial frictions and examines responses to shocks, including a novel angle on preference shocks. We show that these market-driven transition shocks generate larger macro financial instability than carbon pricing for a given change in emissions, while delaying environmental gains. We then compare policy responses according to their timing. Ex-ante macroprudential policies that reduce banks’ exposure to transition risk dampen financial amplification, whereas ex-post interventions, such as quantitative easing, provide only partial stabilization once losses have materialized. Overall, our results indicate that market-led adjustments to transition risk are more destabilizing than carbon pricing, whereas preventive financial measures limit macro-financial instability more effectively than ex-post interventions under the policy comparisons considered, supporting the case for early action.
abstract_zh: 中央银行和金融监管当局需要应对金融稳定风险可能实现的情况，在危机发生时采取预防性措施或动用流动性。转型风险——与脱碳相关的稳定性风险——就是一个典型例子。此类风险不仅源于政策变化，还来自偏好冲击。为此，本文构建了一个包含金融摩擦的环境动态随机一般均衡模型，并从偏好冲击这一新颖视角考察了各冲击的响应。研究表明，在给定排放变化条件下，这些市场驱动的转型冲击比碳定价引发更大的宏观金融不稳定，同时延迟环境效益的实现。随后，我们根据政策实施时机比较了不同政策应对措施。事前宏观审慎政策通过降低银行对转型风险的敞口来抑制金融放大效应，而事后干预措施（如量化宽松）在损失发生后仅能提供部分稳定效果。总体而言，我们的结果表明，市场主导的转型风险调整比碳定价更具不稳定性，而在所考虑的政策比较中，预防性金融措施比事后干预更能有效限制宏观金融不稳定，这为尽早采取行动提供了支持依据。

abstract: This paper is an attempt to gauge how much the conclusions derived from the standard analysis of labour supply may have to be altered when we allow for such 'unemployed' workers. For the sample of married women in the UK which we investigate, the standard model appears to exaggerate the positive impact which reductions in marginal wages may have on participation and reduces the possibilities for a backward-bending supply curve of labour. The probability of being in a state of unemployment, as defined above, is found to depend on certain demand-side factors, age and a number of other demographic characteristics.
abstract_zh: 本文旨在评估，当我们将此类“失业”工人纳入考量时，标准劳动供给分析所得结论可能需要做出多大程度的修正。基于我们所研究的英国已婚女性样本，标准模型似乎夸大了边际工资下降对劳动参与率的正向影响，并降低了劳动供给曲线向后弯曲的可能性。研究发现，处于上述定义的失业状态的概率取决于某些需求侧因素、年龄以及其他若干人口特征。

abstract: We measure the nature and severity of a variety of belief distortions in market reactions to hundreds of economic news events by synthesizing structural estimation with algorithmic machine learning to quantify bias. We find that investors systematically overreact to perceptions about multiple fundamental shocks, a phenomenon we show often dampens rather than amplifies market volatility via a “shock composition effect.” Such effects imply that the stock market can underreact to news, even when investors overreact to all shocks. abstract_zh: 我们通过将结构估计与算法机器学习相结合，量化了市场对数百个经济新闻事件反应中多种信念扭曲的性质与严重程度。研究发现，投资者系统性地对多重基本面冲击的感知过度反应，这一现象通常通过“冲击构成效应”抑制而非放大市场波动。此类效应表明，即使投资者对所有冲击均过度反应，股票市场仍可能对新闻反应不足。（JEL分类号：E7, E27, E32, E17, G4）

abstract: We provide long-run regional evidence on how local support for Brexit is associated with post-referendum life satisfaction. Covering 348 UK local authorities from 2011 to 2022, we find that after the 2016 referendum higher district-level Leave vote shares are associated with relative increases in life satisfaction. These results are robust across alternative treatment definitions, dynamic specifications, regional sensitivity checks and controls for the COVID-19 pandemic. Additional analyses suggest that the association emerges immediately after the referendum, is stronger in structurally vulnerable districts, and is weaker in areas with stronger petition-based demand for reversing Brexit. The findings may be associated with a regional political "winner effectâ€ and/or may reflect alignment between regional political preferences and the referendum outcome.
abstract_zh: 我们提供了关于英国脱欧地方支持度与公投后生活满意度之间关系的长期区域证据。覆盖2011年至2022年间英国348个地方政府区域，我们发现2016年公投后，地区级脱欧投票份额较高与生活满意度的相对提升相关联。这些结果在替代性处理定义、动态规格、区域敏感性检验及对COVID-19疫情的控制下均保持稳健。进一步分析表明，这一关联在公投后立即显现，在结构脆弱地区更为显著，而在有更强请愿要求逆转脱欧的地区则较弱。这些发现可能与区域政治“赢家效应”有关，和/或反映了区域政治偏好与公投结果的一致性。

title: The Green Revolution and individualism: Evidence from Indonesia
title_zh: 绿色革命与个人主义：来自印度尼西亚的证据

official: 官方在线 2026-07-16 · 来源：RSS
abstract: This paper studies the effects of the Green Revolution, one of the largest development projects in the late 20th-Century, on individualism. We use a difference-in-differences approach to investigate how rapid technological and organizational changes in traditional agriculture reshaped cultural norms in Indonesia, where Green Revolution rollout was largely driven by centralized government interventions. Regions with greater exposure to Green Revolution policies experienced significant and persistent increases in individualism (as measured by a higher prevalence of infrequent names) decades after the end of the program. Results are not driven by pre-trends and hold across a battery of robustness checks. We further document suggestive, correlational evidence of a persistent fall in community funding for public goods, a key measure of collective action. Our findings suggest that technical change can lead to rapid and persistent changes in culture.
abstract_zh: 本文研究20世纪末最大规模发展项目之一——绿色革命对个人主义的影响。我们采用双重差分法，探究传统农业中快速的技术与组织变革如何重塑印度尼西亚的文化规范。在该国，绿色革命的推广主要由中央政府干预驱动。研究显示，在项目结束数十年后，受绿色革命政策影响较大的地区，其个人主义（以罕见名字出现频率升高为衡量指标）显著且持续增强。该结果不受事前趋势影响，并通过了一系列稳健性检验。我们进一步发现具有提示性的相关证据：作为集体行动关键指标的公共品社区资金投入持续下降。研究结果表明，技术变革能够引发文化快速且持久的变迁。

title: Quantitative Easing and Government Debt Sustainability
title_zh: 量化宽松与政府债务可持续性

authors: Wenhao Li, Sebastian A. Merkel
official: 官方在线 2026-07-02 · 来源：出版社网页
abstract: We show that quantitative easing (QE) worsens government debt sustainability. In our model, the government has a negative primary balance and downward-sloping debt demand that makes interest rates endogenous. The central bank has long-term capital and remits profits to the fiscal authority. QE depletes this capital stock, reducing future remittances and crisis-fighting reserves. Contrary to Sargent and Wallace (1981), where greater monetary accommodation lowers the steady-state debt level, we show that QE increases the steady-state level of debt and shifts the default boundary inward, thus heightening fragility and reducing debt sustainability. Moreover, while QE can keep interest rates low for extended periods, sustaining a QE-backed rate peg requires a growing central-bank footprint and accelerating capital depletion, until financing costs rise sharply. Under certain parameters, large-scale QE makes previously sustainable debt levels unsustainable, leading ultimately to sovereign default.
abstract_zh: 我们证明，量化宽松（QE）会恶化政府债务可持续性。在我们的模型中，政府存在负的初级财政余额和向下倾斜的债务需求曲线，这使得利率具有内生性。央行持有长期资本，并将利润上缴给财政部门。量化宽松消耗了这部分资本存量，减少了未来的上缴利润和应对危机的储备。与Sargent和Wallace（1981）的结论——即更大的货币宽松程度会降低稳态债务水平——相反，我们证明量化宽松提高了稳态债务水平，并将违约边界向内推移，从而加剧了脆弱性并降低了债务可持续性。此外，尽管量化宽松能在较长时间内维持低利率，但维持量化宽松支撑的利率盯住政策需要央行资产负债表持续扩张和资本加速消耗，直至融资成本急剧上升。在特定参数条件下，大规模量化宽松会使原本可持续的债务水平变得不可持续，最终导致主权违约。

official: 官方在线 2026-07-01 · 来源：出版社网页
abstract: Multidimensional poverty metrics offer a more complete picture of poverty than monetary poverty, yet their adoption has been limited by data constraints. Often not all dimensions in a multidimensional measure are observed in the same survey, leading to countries being excluded from global measures. This study introduces a novel data fusion approach to estimate multidimensional poverty metrics by combining summary statistics from multiple data sources. The proposed method is validated by simulating typical missing data scenarios using 571 household surveys from 112 countries (1989–2024) to estimate the World Bank’s Multidimensional Poverty Measure. The fusion method accurately predicts various multidimensional poverty metrics across these scenarios, even in the presence of simulated sample bias reflecting differences in survey design. It enables estimates of multidimensional poverty for a greater number of countries, gap-filling in time series, and the inclusion of previously unavailable indicators and dimensions in global multidimensional poverty measures.
abstract_zh: 多维贫困指标相比货币贫困能更全面地反映贫困状况，但其应用受限于数据约束。由于多维贫困指标中的各个维度往往无法在同一项调查中完整观测，导致许多国家被排除在全球性贫困测度之外。本研究提出一种创新的数据融合方法，通过整合多个数据源的汇总统计量来估算多维贫困指标。该方法利用112个国家（1989-2024年）的571项家庭调查数据，通过模拟典型数据缺失场景对世界银行多维贫困测度进行验证。结果表明，即便在存在反映调查设计差异的模拟样本偏差时，该融合方法仍能准确预测各类多维贫困指标。该方法不仅能够为更多国家提供多维贫困估算，填补时间序列数据缺口，还能将此前无法获取的指标和维度纳入全球多维贫困测度体系。

official: Crossref 元数据日期 2026-07-06 · 来源：Crossref
abstract: Balancing cropland protection and abandonment is a major challenge for sustainable food production. The link between cropland abandonment and reclamation is still unclear, making it hard to assess their combined effects on land use. Here we use 30-m resolution remote sensing data (1992–2020) and geographically weighted regression to analyze cropland dynamics across 343 Chinese prefectures. We find that abandonment (56.28 Mha) and reclamation (55.72 Mha) exceed net cropland change, revealing massive hidden transitions. Spatial analysis identifies expanding collective hot spots where both processes co-occur, particularly in ecologically fragile regions. Abandonment shows a strong positive correlation with subsequent reclamation, explaining 63–84% of reclamation patterns, which is substantially more than the combined influence of natural and socioeconomic factors (61–78%). These findings indicate that stable cropland totals may conceal the hidden cropland transition and potential suitability mismatches, highlighting the need to incorporate gross transitions and land quality into sustainable cropland management.
abstract_zh: 平衡耕地保护与撂荒是可持续粮食生产面临的重大挑战。耕地撂荒与复垦之间的关联仍不明确，难以评估二者对土地利用的联合效应。本研究利用1992—2020年30米分辨率遥感数据及地理加权回归方法，分析了中国343个地级市的耕地动态变化。研究发现，撂荒面积（5628万公顷）与复垦面积（5572万公顷）均超过耕地净变化量，揭示了大规模隐性转换的存在。空间分析识别出两类过程同时发生的扩展性集聚热点区域，尤其在生态脆弱地区表现突出。撂荒与后续复垦呈显著正相关，可解释复垦格局的63%—84%，远超自然与社会经济因素的综合影响（61%—78%）。这些发现表明，稳定的耕地总量可能掩盖隐性耕地转换及潜在的土地适宜性错配，凸显了将总转换量和土地质量纳入可持续耕地管理的必要性。

abstract: We assess the empirical evidence for the hypothesis that women more than men respond to changes in treatment. First, we examine whether the results of over two hundred experimental economics papers support the female sensitivity hypothesis. Second, using data from two studies (DellaVigna and Pope, 2022; Exley et al., 2025), we conduct over two hundred pairwise tests of the hypothesis. Both analyses show that gender is not predictive of responsiveness to treatment. We further examine how the hypothesis has been disseminated in the literature and find that it is referenced predominantly by papers that support it.

abstract: In many markets, buyers make discrete choices between differentiated products and negotiate prices that are specific to the choice. We develop for estimation a model for this class of markets which is consistent with non-cooperative models of bargaining between a buyer and competing sellers. We show that when the buyer's utility has GEV disturbances, the model has a tractable likelihood function which can be used with transaction-level data giving the selected product and its price. We estimate the model using data from the UK brick industry and use it to measure market power and analyze mergers. We analyze how spatial differentiation and ownership concentration affect the distribution of market power across transactions. In counterfactuals we find that switching from individually-negotiated to uniform pricing causes markups, and merger price effects, to increase on average but to decrease for a minority of transactions.
abstract_zh: 在许多市场中，买家在差异化产品之间进行离散选择，并协商与选择相关的特定价格。我们针对这类市场开发了一个用于估计的模型，该模型与买家与竞争卖家之间非合作议价模型保持一致。我们证明，当买家效用具有广义极值（GEV）扰动时，该模型具有易于处理的似然函数，可结合提供所选产品及其价格的交易层面数据进行使用。我们利用英国砖业行业的数据对该模型进行估计，并以此衡量市场势力及分析并购。我们研究了空间差异化和所有权集中度如何影响交易间市场势力的分布。在反事实分析中，我们发现从单独协商定价转向统一定价会导致平均加成率及并购价格效应上升，但少数交易的加成率及并购价格效应反而下降。

abstract: We investigate the role of industrial relations for working from home during and after the COVID- 19 pandemic in Germany. Using data from the German Socio-Economic Panel (SOEP) for the years 2020 to 2023 and a special COVID sample (SOEP-CoV) for 2020 and 2021, we examine how collec- tive bargaining and plant-level co-determination are associated with the incidence and frequency of working from home. Controlling for worker, firm, occupation, and industry characteristics, we find that employees covered by a collective bargaining agreement are less likely to work from home and do so less frequently than uncovered employees. In contrast, the incidence and frequency of working from home are positively associated with the presence of a works council.

abstract: Markets are an increasingly popular regulatory choice to cost effectively control negative externalities. Traditionally, market designs have employed a cap-and-trade format that places an absolute limit on the quantity of emissions. In contrast, many new schemes—including the world’s largest in China—limit the aggregate emissions intensity of production. This article theoretically and experimentally compares intensity- and capbased markets. We design a novel laboratory experiment, where firms choose both output and allowance exchange. Consistent with our theoretical predictions, we find that employing an intensity-based market rather than an equivalent cap-and-trade scheme significantly increases aggregate output, average allowance prices, aggregate abatement, and decreases industry profits. Overall, both markets perform as expected and close to the cost effective allocation of pollution abatement but with lower levels of aggregate profit as high production costs types produce significantly more output than predicted.

abstract: We study whether the Coase conjecture holds for bargaining during war. Two players, A and B, contest a divisible resource until one side collapses or agreement is reached. If player B is militarily strong, then he insists on getting a large share. However, player A only concedes this large share if player B credibly signals his strength by fighting a sufficiently long war. Thus, the Coase conjecture fails, and asymmetric information about military strength explains why long wars may be inevitable. Using a mechanism design approach, we derive a lower bound on the expected duration of war. (JEL C78, D74, D82, F51)

abstract: A long-lived seller sells a new product of unknown value by offering prices and recommendations to short-lived consumers in continuous time. The seller receives consumer feedback about the product at a rate that increases with the instantaneous sales volume. The optimal selling mechanism features episodes of price discounts, during which the seller discontinuously lowers the price and offers unwarranted recommendations to consumers. The optimal pricing strategy depends on the nature of consumer feedback and may involve early or late discounts, dynamic price backtracking, and below-cost pricing.

abstract: Utility companies recover their capital costs through regulator-approved rates of return. Using a comprehensive database of utility rate cases, we find a significant premium for regulated returns on equity relative to several capital cost benchmarks. We show that firms decide strategically when to initiate new rate cases, such that regulated returns respond more quickly to increases in underlying capital cost benchmarks than to decreases. Higher regulated returns incentivize utilities to own more capital: a one percentage point rise in return on equity increases capital assets by 3-4%. Overall we find excess costs to US consumers averaging $7 billion per year.

abstract: This paper examines the effects of differences in sectoral compositions between countries on the liberalization of global tariffs in the coalition-proof Nash equilibrium sense. Using a static tariff-setting game with endogenous trade agreements, I develop a competing exporters model with three countries that differ in their sectoral compositions. I consider two settings that are differentiated by the type of trade agreements that countries can sign: free trade agreements (FTAs) and multilateral trade agreements, i.e., no FTAs. I study both symmetric and asymmetric differences in sectoral compositions across countries and find that, contrary to earlier results based on economic size asymmetries, FTAs act as stumbling blocks to the multilateral trading system when countries sufficiently differ in their sectoral compositions. This result is caused by the existence of a free riding incentive. Lastly, I show that permitting internal tariffs in FTAs typically strengthens the free riding incentive under symmetric sectoral differences, and in the asymmetric case may either mitigate or exacerbate the stumbling-block problem depending on countries’ sectoral compositions.
abstract_zh: 本文考察了国家间部门构成差异对全球关税自由化的影响，在联盟证明纳什均衡的意义上进行分析。通过一个具有内生贸易协定的静态关税设定博弈，我构建了一个包含三个部门构成不同的国家的竞争性出口商模型。我考虑了两种设置，其区别在于国家可以签署的贸易协定类型：自由贸易协定（FTAs）和多边贸易协定，即无自由贸易协定的情况。我研究了国家间部门构成的对称和不对称差异，并发现，与先前基于经济规模不对称的结果相反，当国家在部门构成上存在显著差异时，自由贸易协定成为多边贸易体系的绊脚石。这一结果源于搭便车激励的存在。最后，我表明，在对称部门差异下，允许自由贸易协定中的内部关税通常会增强搭便车激励，而在不对称情况下，则可能根据国家的部门构成减轻或加剧绊脚石问题。

abstract: We show that inequality can lead to social unrest in rural India. We develop a theoretical framework in which civilians rationally engage in social unrest to oppose the (unfair) distribution of surplus by the elite. Our model predicts that the likelihood of observing social unrest in a village increases with the sum of distances between the (log) average and the lowest incomes. We test this prediction using unique microdata on bank account information covering 2197 Indian villages. Guided by our theoretical framework, we propose an instrumental variable strategy based on the idea that positive water shocks disproportionately benefit the highest incomes in a village. Our analysis then shows that a 10% increase in our inequality measure leads to a 6.5% rise in the unconditional probability of social unrest in a given village and month.
abstract_zh: 我们证明，不平等可能导致印度农村的社会动荡。我们构建了一个理论框架，其中平民理性地参与社会动荡，以反对精英对剩余（不公平）的分配。我们的模型预测，村庄中出现社会动荡的可能性随（对数）平均收入与最低收入之间距离之和的增加而上升。我们利用覆盖2197个印度村庄的银行账户信息独特微观数据来检验这一预测。基于我们的理论框架，我们提出了一种工具变量策略，其依据是正向水资源冲击不成比例地惠及村庄中最高收入群体。我们的分析随后表明，我们衡量不平等指标的10%增长，会导致特定村庄在特定月份社会动荡的无条件概率上升6.5%。

abstract: We examine the welfare effects of integrating two-sided unbalanced matching markets with randomly heterogeneous preferences. It is well known that integrating balanced matching markets is profitable for both sides when we focus on stable matching outcomes. However, this result can change as soon as markets become slightly unbalanced. Integration results in a welfare gain for those who end up on the short side of the integrated market on average, at the expense of those on the long side. The magnitude of the loss for one side can be as significant as the welfare gain for the other side, making the aggregate welfare effect of the integration infinitesimal relative to each side’s welfare effect.

authors: Michail Anthropelos, Runhuan Feng, Seongyoon Kim
official: Crossref 元数据日期 2026-01-03 · 来源：Crossref
abstract: Risk pooling has become an increasingly critical tool for managing risks among corporations, institutions, states, and nations, with examples including multinational pooling, decentralized insurance schemes, catastrophe risk pooling, and burden sharing for nuclear accidents. Although there has been a rich literature on such practices, little is known from a theoretical viewpoint regarding the operational strategies of risk pools and, in particular, on issues about the effect of a pool’s expansion on each existing member’s welfare. This paper is the first to explore these issues by establishing different notions of consensus for the expansion of a risk pool: strong consensus, where both existing members and new candidates improve their risk measures due to the pool’s expansion, and weak consensus, which refers to the willingness of existing members to remain in the pool. Under optimal risk sharing for each pool, we show that its properties regarding expansion’s effects depend strongly on the underlying pricing rule. For instance, only with risk-adjusted equilibrium pricing are existing members willing to accept highly risky new members, whereas simple linear pricing excludes such members from the pool. Additionally, the impact of exogenous reinsurance on consensus is analyzed under both pricing rules. The established framework offers valuable managerial insights and policy implications, which we illustrate through two indicative case studies based on real data. This paper was accepted by Agostino Capponi, finance. abstract: Consumers are increasingly supporting businesses and brands that align closely with their values, engaging in acts of political consumerism. Despite the growing demand to support minority-owned businesses, discovering these establishments through traditional channels remains challenging. In this study, we examine whether and how online reviews facilitate the discovery of Black-owned businesses. We leverage GPS-enabled foot traffic data, hand-collected data from a directory of Black-owned restaurants, online reviews from Yelp.com, and zip code-level demographic data to understand the potential mechanisms driving this behavior. Our results suggest that Black-owned restaurants receiving reviews mentioning Black ownership as a product attribute experience about a 10% increase in foot traffic compared with those that do not receive such reviews. Furthermore, we find that reviews mentioning Black ownership primarily benefit Black-owned restaurants located in cities with lower segregation and racial isolation and those where minority ownership is not easily inferable from the kind of cuisine served. Our findings also indicate that online reviews mentioning Black ownership increase foot traffic to Black-owned restaurants by enhancing interracial exposure. Non-White consumers who patronize these restaurants experience an increased likelihood of encountering White consumers after the restaurants receive a review mentioning Black ownership. Collectively, our results demonstrate the value of user-generated content in enabling political consumerism, even without targeted interventions from digital platforms or voluntary disclosure of race by business owners. title: Gender Differences in Risk Preferences: Implications for Adoption of Climate Smart Agricultural Technologies
title_zh: 风险偏好的性别差异：对采纳气候智慧型农业技术的影响
title_primary: 风险偏好的性别差异：对采纳气候智慧型农业技术的影响
title_secondary: Gender Differences in Risk Preferences: Implications for Adoption of Climate Smart Agricultural Technologies
authors: Abebe Hailemariam, Jaslin Kalsi, Astghik Mavisakalyan
source: Australian Journal of Agricultural and Resource Economics
official: 官方在线 2025-10-06 · 来源：RSS
abstract: The gender gap in risk preferences in rural farm households, with female farmers commonly viewed as more risk‐averse than their male counterparts, may have profound implications for addressing the gendered impacts of climate change. Understanding these gender differences and their drivers is essential for designing policies that enhance resilience to the adverse effects of climate change and promote gender equality. In this paper, we examine whether a gender gap in risk‐taking behaviours exists, identify its key drivers and explore its implications for gender disparity in the adoption of climate‐smart agriculture technologies. Using representative longitudinal survey data from the Thailand and Vietnam Socio‐Economic Panel (TVSEP) and employing an interactive fixed effect model and quantile regressions, we find strong evidence of gender differences in risk‐taking behaviour, which contribute to gender disparities in the adoption of climate‐smart agricultural technologies. The results from the decomposition exercise show that improving access to education in rural communities could play a crucial role in bridging the gender gap in risk‐taking, thereby contributing to more equitable and widespread adoption of practices that are key to climate change mitigation and adaptation.
abstract_zh: 农村农户中风险偏好的性别差异，通常认为女性农民比男性更为风险规避，这一现象可能对应对气候变化中的性别影响具有深远意义。理解这些性别差异及其驱动因素，对于设计旨在增强对气候变化不利影响抵御能力并促进性别平等的政策至关重要。本文旨在探讨风险承担行为中是否存在性别差异，识别其关键驱动因素，并分析这些差异对采纳气候智能农业技术性别不平等的影响。利用来自泰国和越南社会经济面板调查（TVSEP）的代表性纵向数据，并采用交互固定效应模型及分位数回归方法，我们发现风险承担行为中存在显著的性别差异，这些差异进而导致了气候智能农业技术采纳上的性别不平等。分解分析结果显示，改善农村社区的教育机会可能在缩小风险承担性别差距方面发挥关键作用，从而促进对气候变化减缓与适应至关重要的实践更加公平和广泛地采纳。

title: Customer Discrimination in the Workplace: Evidence from Online Sales
title_zh: 职场中的顾客歧视：来自在线销售的证据
title_primary: 职场中的顾客歧视：来自在线销售的证据
title_secondary: Customer Discrimination in the Workplace: Evidence from Online Sales
authors: Erin Kelley, Gregory Lane, Matthew Pecenco, Edward M. Rubin
official: 官方在线 2024-09-06 · 来源：RSS
abstract: Many workers are evaluated on their ability to engage with customers. We measure the impact of gender-based customer discrimination on the productivity of online sales agents in sub-Saharan Africa. Using a novel framework that randomly varies the gender of names presented to customers without changing worker behavior, we find the assignment of a female-sounding name leads to 50 percent fewer purchases. Customers also lag in responding, are less expressive, and avoid discussing purchases. We show similar results for customers around the world and across workers. Removing customer bias, we find women would be more productive than their male coworkers.
abstract_zh: 许多工人的工作表现取决于其与客户互动的能力。本研究衡量了基于性别的客户歧视对撒哈拉以南非洲地区在线销售代理生产率的影响。通过采用一种新颖的实验框架——在不改变工人实际行为的前提下，随机向客户展示不同性别的姓名——我们发现，使用女性化姓名会导致购买量减少50%。客户不仅回复延迟、表达更不积极，还会回避讨论购买事宜。全球范围内的客户及不同工人群体均呈现类似结果。若消除客户偏见，女性工人的生产率将高于其男性同事。
